programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs
programme.desc: Zane takes help from Nya for backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code. Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Spooky Sensation

programme.title: Sings of Love

programme.title: Video Wonder
programme.desc: Olivia and Andrea visited science camp with Mrs Stevens. On the other hand, Andrea and Mia decides to return a lost skunk to nature. Andrea was reading intimate postcards between Chef Pierre and Mrs. Stevens.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Curried Smurfs: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Hopping Cough Smurfs: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Sorcerer Smurf: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs

He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs

Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: All the world's a stage

programme.title: The Tops and the Roots
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Ali Baba
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Tom Thumb
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Wee Little Havroshechka
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Tour de Forest
programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.title: What's Inside?
programme.desc: "What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

programme.title: Try, Try Again
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: The Frog Princess

With time ticking away, the mismatched dozen are forced to work together to keep the peace and work toward their payday. programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is Band Nah! Band Nah is composed of vocalist and guitarist Nah Sang-hyun drummer Kang Hyun-woong and bassist Paiiek. The three students at Seoul National University met each other through the school's composition club and then they released their first song together in 2014 as part of the Why Not Study project organized by the university. The following year they made their official debut in the music scene and have been actively growing their discography and exploring further new facets of their sound since then. Their performance of the song Nights received rave reviews in VOCALPLAY 2 in 2019 and then in 2020 they won the Rookie Green Friends of the Greenplugged-Seoul 2020 making us anticipate their future. In this episode Band Nah performs Lights Life Colour Are You There? All The Time and Nights to show off their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and take a glimpse into their artistic world!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Motte! Motte burst into the music scene in September 2017 with the single Tickin' Then in 2018 she released her first full-length album Between and got nominated for Best Rookie at the prestigious Korean Music Awards. With her stage name based on the Harry Potter saga's villain Voldemort she sings about the struggles loneliness and many other things that today's youth experiences. She's been also actively expanding her reach in the music industry taking part in the soundtracks of A-TEEN Romance Is a Bonus Book My Strange Hero and When the Camellia Blooms as well as the Beautiful Mint Life Festiva and the Let's Rock Festival. Last but not least she's dubbed the idol of the indie scene thanks to her cute appearance. In this episode Motte performs Don't Run Away Non-Alcohol Fireplace and more to showcase the essence of her musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the duo HOONS! HOONS is composed of two musicians of the same age - vocalist Lee Sang-hoon and keyboardist Lee Jong-hoon. They met each other in university and then made their debut together in 2016 with the single To You I Am. Thanks to their soft mellow music and sweet lyrics the duo mesmerized the public immediately and they are certainly making their way in the music industry building their fanbase and having their music featured in various TV shows. In this episode HOONS performs I C U Can't hide a love and many others to showcase the essence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet the duo!

programme.title: Paapnaashini Ganga
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Hamare
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Safarnama

This journey is to witness numerous unseen moments and unfelt experiences via a thrilling, adventurous route. It isn't just about navigating roads using GPS but more of digging deeper into the beauty of India to understand life better.

programme.title: Lost Recipes
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Wellbeing behind the wheel – The new Bentley Azure Range
programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.desc: The turbocharged three-litre flat-six in the new 911 GTS delivers 353 kW (480 PS). Maximum torque is 570 Nm, an increase of 20 Nm over its predecessor. Zero to 100 km/h takes just 3.3 seconds (911 Carrera 4 GTS: Fuel consumption combined (NEDC) 10.5 – 9.7 l/100 km, Fuel consumption combined (WLTP) 11.4 – 10.6 l/100 km, CO₂ emissions combined (NEDC) 240 – 222 g/km, CO₂ emissions combined (WLTP) 259 – 240 g/km) in the 911 Carrera 4 GTS Coupé with the eight-speed Porsche dual-clutch transmission (PDK): three tenths faster than its predecessor. programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. Both the offset test and the full-width crash test highlighted marginal chest injury protection for average male and small female drivers, and neither car was equipped with a centre airbag for far-side crash protection, a countermeasure which is increasingly common on modern cars. Both cars offer plenty of crash avoidance technology but do not include some of the latest advancements introduced in the market. The cars' four-star ratings apply also to their PHEV variants.

programme.title: 6 Month Journey: Front Room Makeover
programme.desc: It's been a long time comin' but my front room makeover is finally complete!

programme.title: Four Corners
programme.desc: This time, Mike's planned 48 hours in New Mexico... And he's determined to show the guys as much of it as possible!! From the White Sands National Park, to Hatch, Santa Fe, Albuquerque and Taos! How do you think he'll get on??!

programme.title: Four Corners
programme.desc: Finishing their Four Corners adventure, it's Barry's turn, and he's not exactly known for his organization skills! Watch as he takes the friends from Grand Junction to the Grand Mesa and on to Vail and Boulder... How will the guys judge him, and who will be the overall winner?!

programme.title: USA Through the Great Outdoors
programme.desc: Place is inextricably linked to who we are as human beings. See the American Great Outdoors in its purest and most authentic light – through the eyes of locals.

programme.title: USA Through Food
programme.desc: A journey through the USA, through the diverse food scenes of six vibrant cities.

programme.title: Small Town, Big Story
programme.desc: Dylan discovers Kennett Square, Pennsylvania, a vibrant town producing over 70% of America's mushrooms.

programme.title: Small Town, Big Story
programme.desc: If there's one thing that the town of Abbeville can teach you, it's that you can't make a good Cajun omelet without breaking a 'few' eggs - over 5,000 of them.

programme.title: Small Town, Big Story
programme.desc: Dylan explores the world of Hatch chilis and meets the farmers and community in this New Mexico valley known for bringing these unique peppers to life - one tingly, tasty, spicy bite at a time.

programme.title: Roadfood Adventures USA
programme.desc: Travel along the West to some of the most colorful roads, delicious food, magnificent scenery, magic moments, and fascinating people all along the way.

programme.title: National Parks Adventure
programme.desc: A team of modern day explorers take an off-trail adventure through the national parks of the USA, showing the awe-inspiring beauty found within America's most legendary outdoor playgrounds.

programme.title: Epic Trails
programme.desc: Eric explores Utah's breathtaking slot canyons on a multi-day backpacking adventure.

programme.title: Epic Trails
programme.desc: Eric travels to the mountain towns of Durango and Telluride, Colorado to explore the backcountry by ski, snowshoe, and ice axe.

programme.title: Into America's Wild
programme.desc: Step off the beaten path and connect to your inner trailblazer in this cross-country journey to some of the most beautiful but little-known landscapes of North America.

programme.title: Kung fu Mamma
programme.desc: Un agente segreto in pensione torna in servizio per fermare un trafficante d'armi.

programme.title: Frammenti di follia
programme.desc: La Dott. Dupont inizia un nuovo lavoro in un ospedale psichiatrico. All'improvviso è lei stessa una paziente.

programme.title: 100% Coco
programme.desc: La tredicenne Coco ama la moda e sogna di diventare un'icona di stile.

programme.title: 100% Coco New York
programme.desc: Coco ha vinto un corso alla New York Fashion School e può frequentare i circoli più di tendenza di New York.

programme.title: Campeggio a 5 stelle
programme.desc: Katie ha l'occasione di scrivere un reportage su un campeggio di lusso per la sua rivista. Qui conosce Will.

programme.title: Knock Knock
programme.desc: Evan, un architetto felicemente sposato, sembra avere tutto ciò che un uomo può mai desiderare. Durante un fine settimana da solo, Evan vede la sua tranquilla esistenza interrotta dall'arrivo improvviso di due ragazze apparentemente innocenti.

programme.title: Lo sciacallo: Nightcrawler
programme.desc: Louis non riesce a trovare lavoro. Un giorno assiste per caso a un incidente stradale e ha un'illuminazione: si procura una videocamera e da quel momento passa le notti correndo sui luoghi delle emergenze, per riprendere le scene più cruente e vendere il materiale ai network televisivi.

programme.title: Amore E Altri Disastri
programme.desc: Londra. Emily "Jacks" Jackson lavora per Vogue, vive con il miglior amico, l'omosessuale Peter Simon, sceneggiatore in cerca del grande amore, e s'incontra con James, ex ragazzo con cui rifiuta una relazione stabile, ma vuole solo continuare ad andarci a letto.

programme.title: Bulletproof Man
programme.desc: Estate 1976. 36 bombe esplodono nel cuore di Cleveland mentre infuria la guerra per il controllo del territorio tra la mafia italiana e il gangster irlandese Danny Greene che ha smesso di prendere ordini per tentare la propria scalata al potere.

programme.title: Act of Valor
programme.desc: Il salvataggio di un agente della CIA rapito porta alla scoperta di un complotto terroristico contro gli Stati Uniti. Una squadra di Navy Seal, viene così coinvolta in una caccia all'uomo di portata mondiale.

programme.title: The Last Warrior
programme.desc: La pace e la tranquillità si sono insediate a Belogoria. Il male è stato sconfitto e Ivan si sta godendo la meritata fama.

programme.title: Air Buddies
programme.desc: E' arrivata la nuova generazione del famoso franchise di successo Air Bud! Questa volta i protagonisti sono u cinque cuccioli di Air Bud, i Buddies, impegnati in una missione di salvataggio per salvare i loro genitori.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.desc: S1:E45 La caccia ai tartufi - I Puffi adorano i tartufi, ma i tartufi appartengono ai Trolls. E i Trolls vivono ai peidi del Monte Tratufo nel cui largo si nasconde la terribile Cosa senza Nome.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.sub-title: S1:E46 Il Grande Puffo si sposa
programme.desc: S1:E46 Il Grande Puffo si sposa - Grande Puffo si innamora di una ninfa dei boschi di nome Campanellina, ignaro del fatto che il suo fascino seducente fa parte di un complotto ordito da Baldassarre per catturare tutti gli animali del bosco, nel suo ultimo piano per rovesciare Lord Homnibus e governare il regno con mano autocratica.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.desc: S1:E47 I Puffi navigatori - Grande Puffo ricorda l'emozionante viaggio di Sognatore in alto mare e le sue avvincenti avventure con tartarughe marine, balene, isole deserte... e pirati!

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.desc: S1:E48 Il Puffo Nobel - Hogartha si traveste da Premio Puffo d'Oro per catturare i Puffi e usarli come ingrediente principale nella sua crema di bellezza.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.desc: S1:E49 L'ultimo cespuglio di Puffragole - Grande Puffo organizza un equipaggio per salpare verso l'isola delle Puffbacche perché Gargamella ha teso una trappola uccidendo tutti gli alberi della terraferma tranne uno.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.sub-title: S1:E50 Agata si innamora | Una campana per Birba
programme.desc: S1:E50 Agata si innamora | Una campana per Birba - Hogartha promette a Gargamella un fischietto magico se lui le presenterà lo stregone dei suoi sogni. | Quattrocchi convince i Puffi a fabbricare una campana e a metterla ad Azrael per avvertirli quando il gatto è vicino.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.sub-title: S1:E51 Un giorno da Puffetta | Gli orecchini magici
programme.desc: S1:E51 Un giorno da Puffetta | Gli orecchini magici - Forzuto si veste come Puffetta per attirare uno gnomo innamorato, Piltkin, lontano dal villaggio. | Hogartha ottiene gli orecchini magici, che le permettono di sentire le voci dei Puffi da lontano.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.sub-title: S1:E52 Lacrime di Puffo | La festa dell'arcobaleno
programme.desc: S1:E52 Lacrime di Puffo | La festa dell'arcobaleno - Una bella principessa viene trasformata in una strega e ha bisogno dei baffi di un gatto e della lacrima di un Puffo per l'antidoto. | Grande Puffo riceve la ricetta per fare un arcobaleno da Madre Natura.

programme.title: Ingannevole è il cuore più di ogni cosa
programme.desc: Jeremiah, sette anni, è stato rimosso dalla sua famiglia adottiva e si ritrova immerso in una vita difficile in viaggio con sua madre, Sarah.

programme.title: Ritratto di borghesia in nero
programme.desc: Una giovane e splendida Ornella Muti in un vortice di passioni nella Venezia degli anni '30. Mattia, un giovane studente di pianoforte, fa amicizia con Renato, del quale conosce la madre Carla. Mattia e Carla iniziano segretamente una relazione, interrotta bruscamente dal geloso Renato. La donna, profondamente ferita da questo tradimento, inizia a coltivare un desiderio di vendetta.

programme.title: Il medico... la studentessa
programme.desc: Dopo la promozione, Claudia ( Gloria Guida ) si appresta a partire per Londra con alcuni compagni. Ma quando la matrigna Luisa induce il padre a revocare il consenso, la studentessa liceale scoprirà che la donna sta tramando qualcosa per potersi gettare tra le braccia dell'amante, il dottor Filippo Cinti. Claudia - con l'aiuto dell'amica Daniela - mediterà vendetta...

programme.title: Basta con la guerra… facciamo l'amore
programme.desc: Lo zio di un seminarista decide che il nipote dev'essere spinto a esplorare l'interesse verso le donne e, per aiutarlo, si fa assistere dalla moglie e dalla cameriera.

programme.title: Gli amici di Nick Hezard
programme.desc: Per vendicare la morte del suo amico, un giovane lestofante in Svizzera predispone un'ingegnosa truffa ai danni del principale responsabile, un affarista americano. Gli fa credere di esser stato coinvolto in un omicidio e fa in modo di sottrargli una grossa quantità di denaro. L'attuazione del piano, però, non sarà affatto semplice.

programme.title: Il Mantenuto
programme.desc: Stefano Garbelli, impiegato romano, viene coinvolto dalla prostituta Daniela, che lo indica come suo protettore per difendersi dai magnaccia. Daniela si finge infermiera, suscitando l'interesse di Stefano. Inconsapevolmente, Stefano diventa il suo protettore agli occhi dei rivali e della polizia, che lo convoca al commissariato insieme agli aggressori.

programme.title: L'impiegato
programme.desc: Splendida commedia con Nino Manfredi. Estremamente ligio al lavoro, un giovane impiegato non si concede mai distrazioni di alcun genere, sfogando tutte le sue pulsioni più intime ed i suoi desideri di realizzazione con intensi sogni. Il suo mondo sembra sgretolarsi con l'arrivo di una donna a capo dell'azienda che metterà a soqquadro le sue abitudini. Diretta da Gianni Puccini.

programme.title: Camping
programme.desc: Frizzante commedia diretta da Zeffirelli. I giovani fidanzati Tao e Valeria decidono di prendersi una vacanza per sfuggire alla routine, ma i genitori di Valeria, diffidenti verso Tao, insistono che il fratello di lei, Nino, li accompagni. Dopo un viaggio movimentato in sidecar, arrivano in un campeggio frequentato da turisti tedeschi, affascinati dalla bellezza di Valeria.

programme.title: Amore mio aiutami
programme.desc: Giovanni e Raffaella sono una coppia affiatata da dieci anni. La relazione va però in crisi quando Raffaella s'innamora di Valerio, un piacente quarantenne. Raffaella è quindi invaghita della nuova fiamma ma, confidando nella comprensione del marito che si vanta da sempre del suo essere moderno, aperto e razionale, chiede il suo aiuto.

programme.title: Amori di mezzo secolo
programme.desc: Capolavoro italiano diretto da grandi registi come Roberto Rossellini e Antonio Pietrangeli, interpretato da celebri attori come Alberto Sordi, Silvana Pampanini, Franco Interlenghi e Leonora Ruffo. A scandire il tempo è la guerra e gli amori che provano a sfidarla. Cinque intrecci sentimentali che percorrono la storia, lungo un arco di trent'anni che copre Prima e Seconda Guerra Mondiale.

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: Splendor
programme.desc: Il proprietario, il proiezionista e la maschera di una sala di provincia che sta per chiudere i battenti si abbandonano ai ricordi: ma quando gli operai stanno già schiodando le poltrone...

programme.title: C'era una volta
programme.desc: Napoli, XVII secolo. Il principe Rodrigo Ferrantte y Davalos, nobile spagnolo di grande fascino e coraggio, è in Italia. Deve trovare una sposa e la corte gli impone la scelta tra sette belle principesse. Ma lui s`innamora di una paesana, semplice, fiera e sanguigna, di rara bellezza e di incredibili virtù, di nome Isabella. Il loro amore, fulmineo e improvviso, incontrerà molti ostacoli...

programme.title: Ieri, oggi e domani
programme.desc: Trio di novelle, tre ritratti di donna che si avvalgono dell`eclettico brio interpretativo di Sophia Loren. Da un soggetto di Eduardo De Filippo: "Adelina", napoletana che vende sigarette di contrabbando e, per evitare il carcere, sforna figli a ripetizione da una novella di Aberto Moravia: "Anna", ricca milanese che, per noia, tradisce il marito con un giovane intellettuale squattrinato da un soggetto di Cesare Zavattini: "Mara", squillo d`alto bordo che fa invaghire un giovane seminarista.

programme.title: El abrazo partido: L'abbraccio perduto
programme.desc: Nel cuore di Buenos Aires, Ariel vive e lavora in un centro commerciale. Mentre sua madre gestisce un negozio, lui indaga sul passato della sua famiglia e sul padre che ha abbandonato tutto per combattere in Israele. La verità emergerà con il ritorno inaspettato del genitore, portando nuove consapevolezze.

programme.title: And then I go
programme.desc: Edwin e Flake frequentano le scuole medie e soffrono di uno stato di ansia. Incompresi dalle loro famiglie e demoralizzati a scuola ogni giorno, la loro furia cova finché un'idea di vendetta non offre loro una terrificante liberazione.

programme.title: The Iron Lady
programme.desc: Margaret Thatcher, l'unica donna a guidare il Regno Unito, rivive la sua ascesa politica e le sfide del potere. Tra successi, critiche e ricordi personali, il film svela il ritratto intimo di una delle figure più influenti del XX secolo.

programme.title: Hellzapoppin'
programme.desc: Ole e Chick stanno girando un film, ma il regista non è soddisfatto. Così ingaggia un giovane scrittore, che proporrà una storia assurda.

programme.title: Il posto delle fragole
programme.desc: Il professor Isak Borg intraprende un viaggio per ricevere un riconoscimento accademico. Il tragitto diventa un percorso interiore tra sogni e ricordi che lo spingono a confrontarsi con il passato e il senso della vita.

programme.title: CONSULENTE D'AMORE
programme.desc: Il Date Whispering è la nuova tendenza nel mondo degli appuntamenti, e tra tutti i date whisperer di Los Angeles, Sam è la migliore. Ma quando il valore del suo servizio viene messo in discussione dal life coach di suo padre, Mattie, imparerà il vero valore dell'amore autentico.

programme.title: IL CLUB DELL'AMORE: IL VIAGGIO DI SYDNEY
programme.desc: Sydney è un'ex atleta che ora fa la food blogger. In tutto questo, nel suo cuore non sembra mai essere passata la cotta per Theo, suo ex cmpagno di college. E rivedersi dopo 10 anni cambierà qualcosa?

programme.title: Rodeo & Juliet
programme.desc: Juliet, ragazza di città, va in campagna con la madre per le vacanze. Mentre la madre ritroverà un vecchio amore, Juliet scoprirà una nuova passione per l'equitazione… grazie anche al cowboy che le insegna a cavalcare

programme.title: I Toni dell'Amore
programme.desc: Ben (John Lithgow) e Jorge (Alfred Molina), due omosessuali che stanno insieme da 28 anni, decidono finalmente di sposarsi. Quando però uno dei due perde inaspettatamente il proprio lavoro in una scuola cattolica locale, Ben e Jorge si ritrovano costretti a rinunciare al loro appartamento e a vivere separati, mettendo a dura prova il loro amore.

programme.title: 400 Giorni
programme.desc: Quattro astronauti sono scelti dal governo americano per simulare una missione su un lontano pianeta e vengono rinchiusi in un sofisticato bunker sotterraneo per 400 giorni.

programme.title: Souvenir d'italie
programme.desc: La storia di tre turiste straniere: l'inglese Margaret, la francese Josette e la tedesca Hilde che passano la frontiera con l'Italia per visitare il nostro Paese ma un incidente alla loro macchina le costringerà ad arrangiarsi con mezzi di fortuna.

programme.title: Another Happy Day
programme.desc: Alla vigilia del matrimonio di suo figlio, Lynn, una donna che ha sempre nascosto le sue emozioni, insieme ai suoi tre figli dovrà fare i conti con le montagne russe emotive di una riunione di famiglia. Una commedia oscura con Ellen Barkin e Demi Moore.

programme.title: East Is East
programme.desc: Nel 1971 George Khan, pakistano tradizionalista, è emigrato nel Regno Unito dove possiede un negozio di fish & chips e ha sposato Ella. I loro sette figli sembrano poco inclini a seguire le direttive paterne per quanto riguarda la religione islamica.

programme.title: Serving Sara IT
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata notificata della richiesta di divorzio, una donna convince un ufficiale giudiziario ad aiutarla a riottenere ciò che le è dovuto.

programme.title: The Dark
programme.desc: Un mattatoio di Welch è lo scenario di una serie di eventi misteriosi che colpiscono una giovane famiglia perseguitata dal fantasma arrabbiato di un bambino morto proprio lì anni prima.

programme.title: Friend Request
programme.sub-title: La morte ha il tuo profilo
programme.desc: Laura è una delle ragazze più popolari del college: quando la misteriosa Ma Rina le chiede l'amicizia su un social network, Laura accetta. Ben presto, però, Ma Rina diventa ossessiva e Laura decide di rimuoverla dalla lista degli amici. Una scelta dalle tragiche conseguenze.

programme.title: Pawn
programme.desc: La storia di un gruppo di banditi armati che rapinano un ristorante e scoprono che appartiene alla mafia. Un piccolo furto si trasforma in un rapimento di alcuni ostaggi che si vedranno trascinati in una situazione che coinvolge un ex detenuto, i federali, la polizia locale e la mafia...

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Tre amici trovano milioni di dollari nascosti nel bosco, ma presto scoprono che appartengono a un criminale pericoloso. L'avidità e la paura trasformano il loro legame in un conflitto mortale, mentre cercano di sopravvivere alla furia del legittimo proprietario.

programme.title: Infuso d'amore
programme.desc: Lara, esperta di marketing, vive la sua vita nella grande città, ma viene convocata nella cittadina di Kissing Falls per sistemare gli affari della sua defunta zia che le ha lasciato in eredità il suo negozio di tè. Per realizzare l'ultimo desiderio della zia, e vincere un premio, Lara vuole ricreare un famoso tè, per questo chiede aiuto a Matt, un giovane esperto di fiori molto affascinante.

programme.title: Fragranza d'amore
programme.desc: Dopo la morte prematura del padre, Violet deve consegnare in tempo per San Valentino la terza fragranza di una trilogia di profumi a cui ha lavorato il genitore. Per risalire alla composizione del profumo di cui non conosce la formula, decide di assumere Dec, un esperto botanico. Ben presto, la loro relazione professionale si trasformerà in qualcosa di molto più.

programme.title: Un fidanzato in regalo
programme.desc: Una donna stanca dei suoi genitori che la assillano per trovare un fidanzato fa un patto con un ragazzo che non vuole nemmeno che una relazione si atteggi a suo fidanzato per tenere lontana la sua famiglia fino a dopo la sua festa di compleanno.

programme.title: L'ultimo regalo
programme.desc: Un miliardario defunto lascia al suo viziato nipote adulto una serie di strani compiti da svolgere per ricevere "il regalo finale", con il nipote risentito che non ha idea di cosa potrebbe essere.

programme.title: Puoi baciare la damigella
programme.desc: Scarlett è un'influencer affermata di New York con una passione per la pasticceria. La ragazza, però, dovrà lasciare per breve tempo il suo nuovo impiego per prendere parte al matrimonio di sua sorella, da organizzare all'interno della loro vecchia casa, ora di proprietà del suo ex fidanzato Liam.

programme.title: Boys on the Side
programme.desc: Robin guida la sua auto da New York a Los Angeles con Jane al suo seguito. Fanno una sosta a Pittsburgh per prendere l'amica di Jane, Holly. Il trio parte per un viaggio, fermandosi per un po' a Tucson, e lungo il loro cammino, queste tre donne uniche si legano e formano una forte amicizia.

programme.title: Un amore di damigella
programme.desc: La damigella d'onore professionista Cate James è entusiasta di aiutare la sua migliore amica con il giorno del matrimonio e incontra il bel fratello di Maxine, Matt, che è in città per il matrimonio di sua sorella. Scoccherà la scintilla tra Cate e Matt?

programme.title: Run to me
programme.desc: Alison Wynn è una triatleta dilettante che convince la dottoressa Laura Stevens, una controversa allenatrice di alte prestazioni, ad assumerla come cliente. Insieme intraprendono un rigoroso programma che combina un allenamento fisico all'avanguardia con un'ipnoterapia sperimentale nel tentativo di rendere Alison più competitiva.

programme.title: Radio Rebel
programme.desc: Tara, una timidissima liceale, ha un segreto: è anche una DJ sicura di sé conosciuta come Radio Rebel, che presta la sua voce agli altri.

programme.title: Dopo l'uragano
programme.desc: La vita di un giovanissimo cuoco viene travolta dall'arrivo dell'uragano Sandy nel 2012.

programme.title: Un bambino per due
programme.desc: L'ambiziosa Layla Bennet conduce il programma mattutino Wake Up Chicago! con il suo affascinante collega Derek Dray. Non vanno sempre d'accordo e quando improvvisamente devono prendersi cura di un bambino insieme, il loro incubo peggiore diventa realtà!

programme.title: Amore in ascolto
programme.desc: Peyton Pepper, una produttrice di podcast molto determinata, è costretta a fare di Alex McKinney, una sfacciata mina vagante, la sua prossima star e a realizzare lo show perfetto per salvare le carriere di entrambi. Ma lo spettacolo di Peyton si trasforma nella ricerca del vero amore.

programme.title: L'uomo del mistero
programme.desc: Un'agente letteraria di libri di cucina con una formazione culinaria ha il compito di aiutare a promuovere il marchio di un noto personaggio di un canale gastronomico, conosciuto per le sue ricette orientate alla praticità.

programme.title: Infuso damore
programme.desc: Lara, esperta di marketing, vive la sua vita nella grande città, ma viene convocata nella cittadina di Kissing Falls per sistemare gli affari della sua defunta zia che le ha lasciato in eredità il suo negozio di tè.

programme.title: Il sapore del Natale
programme.desc: Scarlett è chef e comproprietaria di un ristorante. Quest'anno, la sua migliore amica le compra un biglietto per una vacanza culinaria, dove Scarlett imparerà di nuovo la cucina delle feste e forse troverà l'amore in un chef rivale del suo passato.

programme.title: Un appuntamento con il destino
programme.desc: Jack, sceneggiatore in crisi, incontra per caso Maria, una donna affascinante e superstiziosa. Tra rituali, superstizioni e una famiglia invadente, la loro relazione sembra destinata al caos. Riusciranno a superare le loro differenze culturali?

programme.title: Sposami a Natale
programme.desc: Durante i preparativi per una cerimonia natalizia molto importante e sofisticata, Madaline Krug, un'organizzatrice di matrimoni, si innamora inaspettatamente del fratello della sposa.

programme.title: Sotto il segno dellamore
programme.desc: Kelsey lavora per una rivista online e sogna di diventare giornalista. La sua carriera fatica a decollare, fino a quando deve scrivere un articolo scettico sugli oroscopi, insieme a un maestro dell'astrologia.

programme.title: Le ore dell'amore
programme.desc: Gianni e Maretta, che hanno vissuto insieme per tre anni, decidono di sposarsi. Nonostante essi conducano una vita agiata, il matrimonio si rivela per Gianni una situazione insopportabile. Maretta tenta ogni cosa per salvare l'unione, ma si scontra col carattere frivolo e superficiale del marito. Di reciproco accordo decidono così di tornare a vivere da amanti come avevano fatto prima di sposarsi. Una scappatoia che entrambi ritengono necessaria per salvare il salvabile.

programme.title: Flirting with Flamenco
programme.desc: Sylvia, insicura e con problemi sul lavoro, incontra il chitarrista di flamenco Pablo, il quale cambia la sua vita. Ma una rivelazione sconvolgente del padre la mette alla prova: riuscirà a reagire?

programme.title: L'ultimo amore di Casanova
programme.desc: Figlio del XVIII secolo, avventuriero veneziano e amante del piacere, del gioco d'azzardo e dell'avventura: sono questi i tratti che caratterizzano Giacomo Casanova, che - in cerca di nuove emozioni - decide di recarsi a Londra, una città in cui non ha mai messo piede prima. L'unico posto che conosce è quello che gli è stato consigliato dal Cardinale de Bernis, un famoso ed elegante bordello gestito da un francese.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: A Beecham House, una casa di riposo per cantanti lirici e musicisti immersa nella campagna inglese, si prepara come ogni anno il grande spettacolo per l'anniversario della nascita di Giuseppe Verdi. Tutti gli artisti residenti tornano sulla scena per raccogliere fondi per mantenere Beecham e, tra gorgheggi e capricci, rinascono ansie da prima donna, rivalità tra istrioni, isterismi. Qualcuno si sente male, qualcuno beve di nascosto, qualcuno rifiuta di cantare. E, ad aumentare la confusione, arriva una nuova pensionante: la diva della lirica Jean Horton, che ritrova Reggie, Wilf e Cissy, gli altri componenti di un quartetto leggendario. Reggie è il suo ex marito e il quartetto si sciolse quando divorziarono.

programme.title: Appuntamento a ora insolita
programme.desc: Un incontro casuale tra due persone molto diverse, che sfidano le convenzioni sociali e si scoprono in un legame profondo. Un percorso di crescita personale e di scoperta reciproca, tra incomprensioni e intimità.

programme.title: Life In A Day
programme.desc: La vita in un giorno è un film documentario il cui progetto - un esperimento globale per la creazione del più grande lungometraggio generato dagli utenti - è stato annunciato da YouTube il 6 luglio 2010. È classificato come il primo Social Movie della storia

programme.title: La quadriglia dell'amore
programme.desc: Un produttore di riviste e un attore della sua compagnia si recano rispettivamente a Londra e a Parigi per trovare una soubrette per il loro spettacolo. Non solo entrambi hanno successo, ma s'innamorano anche delle loro scoperte.

programme.title: Miseria e Nobiltà
programme.desc: Un giovane figlio di nobili, prevedendo che la sua famiglia non accetterà il suo matrimonio con una ballerina, ingaggia un gruppo di poveracci perché impersonino i suoi parenti davanti ai familiari della fidanzata. I falsi parenti commettono mille gaffes.

programme.title: The Meddler
programme.desc: Una vivace commedia incentrata su una madre (Susan Sarandon), da sempre inguaribile ottimista, che dopo la morte del marito segue la figlia (Rose Byrne) a Los Angeles. Lì inaspettatamente si trova a stringere nuove amicizie e ad innamorarsi di un poliziotto.

programme.title: Drinking Buddies – Amici Di Bevuta
programme.desc: Kate (Olivia Wilde) e Luke (Jake Johnson) lavorano insieme in una fabbrica di birra artigianale. Hanno una di quelle amicizie che sembra poter essere qualcosa di più. Ma Kate è con Chris (Ron Livingston), Luca è con Jill (Anna Kendrick) e Jill vuole sapere se Luke è pronto a parlare di matrimonio. La risposta a questa domanda diventa chiarissima quando Luke e Kate inaspettatamente si trovano da soli per un fine settimana. DRINKING BUDDIES è scritto e diretto da Joe Swanberg ed è interpretato dalle stelle Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson, Anna Kendrick, e Ron Livingston.

programme.title: Fools Rush In (1997)
programme.desc: Alex Whitman (Matthew Perry) è professionista di Manhattan, Isabel Fuentes (Salma Hayek) un'americana di origine messicana che crede nella forza del destino. Nessuno dei due pensa ad eventuali conseguenze quando passano una notte insieme, ma il fato ha qualcosa in serbo per loro. Quando si rincontrano tre mesi dopo, Isabel è incinta e decidono di sposarsi.

programme.title: Ricomincio Da Capo
programme.desc: Bloccato dalla neve in Pennsylvania, per il suo rituale servizio sul “giorno della marmotta”, il metereologo televisivo Phil Connors (Bill Murray) si ritrova fermo nel tempo, costretto a rivivere il 2 febbraio.

programme.desc: Quinto, ladro sfortunato, passa dalle auto ai salumi e ai quadri, finendo sempre in ospedale o in galera

programme.desc: Alberto Sordi interpreta un uomo che, coinvolto in una serie di equivoci e malintesi, si trova a dover affrontare le difficoltà della sua vita matrimoniale. Una commedia che esplora con ironia le dinamiche delle relazioni e del matrimonio.
